question: Where was the last Earth Summit held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rio de Janeiro.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points**

__
 
• The** 2000-2015** Millennium Development targets and the **2015-2030** Global targets are the results of these Earth Summits.
 
• The first summit was held in** Rio de Janeiro (Brazil) in 1992.**
 
• The last Earth Summit, called Rio+20, also took place in **Rio de Janeiro** in **2012.**
 
• The **United Nations Conference on Environment and Development** (UNCED), also called the** 'Earth Summit.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The** Doha** Round is **the latest round of trade negotiations among the WTO membership**. **​ **
 
• The Summit was held in **Johannesburg**, South Africa, from **August 26 to September 4, 2002.**
 
• The motive of the Johannesburg Summit was **to regenerate, at the highest political level, a global commitment to sustainable development and to accelerate action to implement Agenda 21**.
 
• The Kyoto Protocol, also called as the Kyoto Accord, is **an international treaty among industrialized nations that sets mandatory limits on greenhouse gas emissions**.
